raw.rationale: Tetrahydrozoline is an imidazoline adrenergic agonist used topically for ocular vasoconstriction, with no known cytotoxic or antiproliferative mechanism at 2.5 µM; PRISM single-concentration screens of non-cytotoxic launched drugs rarely show lineage-selective killing beyond baseline false-positive rates. Therefore probabilities are set near the low end of the stated 0.2–2.5% per-lineage base rate, with minor variation for lineage screen size and known adrenergic/transporter expression.
